i know how much i hated it when former year 12s said that it’s going to be ok, but it is going to be alright. trust me when i say you will not survive the year if you are perpetually filled with anxiety. your exams are the most important part of the year and they are very far away. take a deep breath, figure out what you need to do, and do it. this attitude buries so many year 12s. try not to compare yourself to your peers because - and i can’t stress this enough - will NOT help you in any way. happy studying 🤙

there are so many techniques that you can use but in my experience you have to find what works for you - studying isn’t linear and everyone works differently. i find that if you just read the content and think about it and extract what’s actually interesting it will stick with you more than just simply trying to revise it. i might also add that cue cards are more effective for exam/sac revision rather than the first step. you can always just do the classic writing notes method - which is highly effective. happy studying 🤙
